MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink bundle felt like a useful next step because it connects with my recent Alexa devices and extends my earlier interest in door security into cameras and a doorbell.",
    "The USB extension cables felt practical because they would make connections easier to reach for my card reader and other peripherals I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo displays and clock-equipped Dot fit my interests, but I recently bought a second-generation Show 5, its stand, and a fourth-generation Dot, so another similar device offers little immediate benefit.",
    "The compact keyboard misses the full-size layout and numeric keypad I just chose, while the internal SSD assumes an upgrade need and computer compatibility that my external-storage purchases do not establish.",
    "The charging cable and headphone adapter address specific connection needs I have not shown; buying other accessories does not mean I currently need these connectors."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest more similar speakers and displays, even when they duplicate devices I recently added.",
    "My history of buying computer accessories seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any cable, adapter, keyboard, or storage upgrade, without a clear purpose for each one."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they show needs I have already filled, especially my keyboard and Alexa display setup.",
    "I care about whether an accessory works with equipment I own and solves a concrete problem, such as reaching USB ports, rather than simply being related to electronics I bought before.",
    "Removable storage interests me, but choosing a larger memory card still depends on needing the capacity and confirming device support."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa devices and practical accessories, but often miss whether an item adds a useful capability or repeats a need I have already filled."
}
